items.title: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata
items.summary_zh: GitHub 发布 CodeQL 2.27.4，重点是提升多语言安全查询的准确率、减少误报，并修正若干查询的 CWE 元数据。更新覆盖 Java/Kotlin、Rust、C/C++ 等语言，同时加强了打包或发布 CodeQL pack 时的安全检查。
items.summary_en: GitHub released CodeQL 2.27.4 with a focus on improving security query accuracy across multiple languages, reducing false positives, and correcting CWE metadata on several queries. The update spans Java/Kotlin, Rust, and C/C++, and also strengthens security checks when bundling or publishing CodeQL packs.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对于将 CodeQL 接入 CI/CD、代码扫描与安全治理流程的团队，这类小版本更新会直接改变告警质量与 triage 成本。更低的误报率意味着更少的开发者噪音，而元数据修正会影响内部漏洞分类、指标报表与合规映射。
items.why_it_matters_en: For teams running CodeQL in CI/CD, code scanning, and security governance workflows, this kind of point release directly affects alert quality and triage cost. Lower false-positive rates reduce developer noise, while metadata corrections can affect internal vulnerability categorization, reporting, and compliance mappings.
key_takeaways_zh: Java/Kotlin 的 log injection 与 path injection 查询识别了更多 sanitizer、guard 与字符串处理路径，能减少漏报与误报。
Rust 与 C/C++ 若干查询的误报被显著收敛；同时多个语言上的 CWE-730 标签被移除，说明下游安全报表与规则映射可能需要重新校准。
key_takeaways_en: Java/Kotlin log-injection and path-injection queries now recognize more sanitizers, guards, and string-handling patterns, improving precision.

Several Rust and C/C++ queries now produce fewer false positives; meanwhile, CWE-730 was removed from multiple queries across languages, which may require downstream reporting and rule-mapping adjustments.

implications_zh: 如果你的组织依赖 CodeQL 告警做安全门禁，建议尽快在代表性仓库上回归扫描，比较误报变化与告警基线漂移。
如果你们将 CWE 标签用于风险分层、自动工单或审计报表，需要检查这次元数据变化是否影响下游自动化。
implications_en: If your organization uses CodeQL alerts as security gates, run regression scans on representative repositories to measure false-positive changes and baseline drift.
If you rely on CWE tags for risk tiering, auto-ticketing, or audit reporting, verify whether the metadata changes alter downstream automation.
